subject: Hosted API: renewal + commit uplift coordination (BrightWare)
messages:
From: Sam Rhodes <sam.rhodes@brightware.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@brightware.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need to accelerate hosted commit for Q3/Q4

Hi Mina,

Quick context — we're seeing earlier-than-expected adoption of the new product search feature and forecasted token consumption for Q3/Q4 looks ~2.6x our current hosted commit. Elena and I ran the numbers and we think a step-up to a 3x monthly commit (with a short-term burst allowance) is needed to avoid throttling during promotions.

Can you confirm:
- Whether we can move from our current 750M token/month committed plan to 2.25B tokens/month under the same billing cadence?
- Any rate-limit or per-route soft-throttle changes we should expect after an uplift?
- What the lead time is for provisioning Dedicated-like throughput on hosted tiers (we may need higher sustained p95 throughput for some inference-heavy routes).

I attached a short forecast and the traffic shape for typical campaign days. We'd like to lock terms before April 7 if possible.

Thanks — appreciate a quick run-down so we can align procurement.

Sam Rhodes
Head of Platform Engineering | BrightWare Inc.
Attachments: BrightWare_MonthlyForecast_Q3-Q4.csv (text/csv, 46KB)
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rhodes <sam.rhodes@brightware.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Elena Park <elena.park@brightware.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to accelerate hosted commit for Q3/Q4

Hi Sam — thanks for the data, this helps. Short answers up front, then a proposed playbook and timeline.

1) Commit uplift: Yes — we can amend your hosted commitment from 750M -> 2.25B tokens/month. We'll need a signed amendment (term + price) and a one-month notice to align provisioning for traffic shaping.
2) Rate-limits / soft-throttle: Uplifted commit increases your per-token rateband and burst cushion; however, for specific high-p95 inference routes we recommend configuring route-level concurrency and enabling prefix caching. If you want, our solution engineers can pre-warm those routes.
3) Lead time: For the hosted-side capacity and priority routing we target 7 business days after amendment execution to complete provisioning and tracing hooks. If you require faster, we can provision a temporary burst lane with a 48–72 hour lead but it carries a short-term surge fee.

Proposed next steps (we can run this in parallel):
- Legal: I'll loop in Marissa to prepare the amendment (price, effective date April 1 or April 15 per your choice).
- Ops: Karthik and Laura will scope route pre-warm and recommend concurrency and caching settings.
- Procurement: Sam/Elena confirm preferred effective date and sign-off authority.

If April 7 is your target to lock terms, let's aim to have a draft amendment in 48 hours and a DocuSign ready for signature within 72 hours.

I'll start the internal handoff now.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0182

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: renewal + commit uplift coordination (BrightWare)

Thanks Mina — noted. Internal ops checklist below to scope change:

- Ingress routing: create priority hash for BrightWare routes (estimated 4 vCPU / 8GB control-plane tweak).
- Model variants: confirm that the models BrightWare uses are set to quantized variants where acceptable to cut cost (we'll confirm ML regression risk).
- Prefix/KV cache: add 2x cache shards for the top 3 heavy routes (estimated improvement: 30–50% token cost reduction on heavy traffic days).
- Soft-throttle windows: configure a soft-throttle at 95th-percentile token rate per route; escalate to manual fallback at 97.5th.
- Provisioning timeline: 5 business days if legal signs by 24 hours. Otherwise 7 business days. Temporary burst lane: 48 hours provisioning, applies surge fee of 15% for the burst volume.

Laura: can you validate if CS wants to run a 2-hour on-call window during the first week post-provisioning for monitoring?

I'll prepare a short MOP doc and an ops-runbook patch for the on-call rotation.

-Karthik
Director, Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: renewal + commit uplift coordination (BrightWare)

Hi Sam / Elena — thanks for moving quickly. Draft amendment attached for review (high-level summary below). If the terms are acceptable, I will send a DocuSign link for signature today so we can meet your requested calendar.

Summary (Draft Amendment BW-4821):
- Current commitment: 750M tokens/month -> New commitment: 2.25B tokens/month (3x)
- Term: 12 months, starts Apr 01 2027 (option for Apr 15 start if requested)
- Pricing: blended rate applied to uplifted band; additional surge fee 15% applied to any temporary burst lane usage
- Soft-throttle & routing: Redwood will enable route-level caching and set soft-throttle windows as discussed; Karthik's team will perform pre-warm.
- Onboarding ops: 2-hour on-call window during week 1 after provisioning (CS to confirm)
- Approvals: Single-signature from BrightWare finance + Sam's engineering confirmation to proceed

Attachments: Draft_Amendment_BW-4821.pdf (PDF, stub)

If you confirm by EOD tomorrow we can have provisioning complete by Apr 6 (assuming Apr 1 term) or Apr 12 (for Apr 15 term). Please indicate preferred effective date and I'll circulate the DocuSign.

Cheers,
